surface_name: Amazon S3 Block Public Access and bucket policies
title: An S3 bucket with Block Public Access off and a public bucket policy serves your files to anyone
symptoms: Objects open in a browser with no signed URL or credentials
The bucket policy allows "Principal": "*" with no limiting Condition
IAM Access Analyzer for S3 lists the bucket as public
cause: New buckets do not allow public access by default, but a bucket policy, access point policy or ACL can grant it once Block Public Access is turned off. S3 treats a policy statement for Principal "*" without a fixed-value condition as public. Block Public Access does not change existing policies, so turning it off makes a bucket with a public policy or ACL public again.
fix: Turn on all four Block Public Access settings on the bucket, and on the account so current and future buckets are covered. If something must be public, such as a static website, keep it in its own bucket and keep user uploads in a private one.
affected: Amazon S3 buckets with Block Public Access turned off and a public bucket policy or ACL
